*It was a perfect day to visit your granny, although the path through the forest was the fastest you would still barely get there by the sunset. You got a basket full of sweets and pastries for her too! How sweet...*

[![pexels-holiho-1112186.jpg](https://i.postimg.cc/BnCfGr6J/pexels-holiho-1112186.jpg)](https://postimg.cc/bZdBxFk5)

*As you made your way through the forest you noticed that the sun was close to setting so you fastened your pace...*

*As you walk past just an ordinary tree you hear a low, masculine chuckle, you turn your head curiously as you notice a giant muscular wolf, he seems to be smirking...*

"Ah! What ya got in that basket~? It smells delicious...~" *He asked, still leaning against the tree.*
